_note: [R] Source of every fixed line the agent speaks. en = English, hi/bn = romanised Hindi/Bengali written by R (respectful register, gender-neutral for the agent's own voice). agent/build_lines.py converts hi/bn to native script into agent/lines.json; keep this file the source of truth. {s} = read-back content.

greet.en: Hello. Tell me, what is troubling you? Take your time, in your own words.
greet.hi: Namaste. Bataiye, kya takleef hai? Aaram se, apne shabdon mein boliye.
greet.bn: Nomoskar. Bolun, ki osubidha hochhe? Dhire sushthe, nijer moto kore bolun.

q_duration.en: Since when has this been happening?

q_age_other.en: How old is the person who is unwell?
q_age_other.hi: Jinki takleef hai, unki umar kitni hai?

q_other.en: Is anything else happening along with it, like fever, vomiting, or trouble breathing?
q_other.hi: Iske saath aur kuch ho raha hai? Jaise bukhar, ulti, ya saans mein takleef?
q_other.bn: Er sathe ar kichhu hochhe? Jemon jor, bomi, ba shash nite koshto?

q_conditions.en: Is there any long-standing illness, like sugar or blood pressure?
q_conditions.hi: Kya pehle se koi bimari hai, jaise sugar ya BP?
q_conditions.bn: Age theke kono rog achhe, jemon sugar ba pressure?

q_medicines.en: Are any medicines being taken right now? Please tell me their names.
q_medicines.hi: Abhi koi dawai chal rahi hai? Uska naam bataiye.
q_medicines.bn: Ekhon kono oshudh khachhen? Naam ta bolun.

q_repeat.en: Sorry, I couldn't hear that clearly. Could you say it once more?
q_repeat.hi: Maaf kijiye, awaaz saaf nahi aayi. Ek baar phir bataiye?
q_repeat.bn: Maf korben, thik bujhte parlam na. Ar ekbar bolben?

q_no_speech.en: No hurry. Tell me whenever you are ready.
q_no_speech.hi: Koi jaldi nahi. Jab tayyar hon, bataiye.
q_no_speech.bn: Kono tara nei. Jokhon prostut, bolun.

readback.en: Here is what I understood: {s}. Is that right?
readback.hi: Maine yeh samjha: {s}. Kya yeh sahi hai?
readback.bn: Ami eta bujhechhi: {s}. Eta ki thik?

q_fix.en: All right. Please tell me what to change.
q_fix.hi: Theek hai. Kya badalna hai, bataiye.
q_fix.bn: Thik achhe. Ki bodlate hobe, bolun.

done.en: Thank you. What you told me will reach the doctor.
done.hi: Dhanyavaad. Aapki baat doctor tak pahunch jayegi.
done.bn: Dhonnobad. Apnar kotha doctor er kachhe pouchhe jabe.

bye_silence.en: That's all right. You can talk to me again whenever you like. Thank you.
bye_silence.hi: Koi baat nahi. Jab chahein, phir se baat kar sakte hain. Dhanyavaad.
bye_silence.bn: Kono osubidha nei. Jokhon ichhe, abar kotha bolben. Dhonnobad.

out_of_scope.en: Only the doctor can answer that. Everything you told me will reach them.
out_of_scope.hi: Yeh doctor hi bata sakte hain. Aapne jo bataya, woh poora unke paas pahunchega.
out_of_scope.bn: Eta doctor-i bolte parben. Apni ja bollen, sob ta onar kachhe pouchhe jabe.

esc_emergency.en: This needs help right now. Call 112 now, or go to the nearest hospital emergency straight away. If you are alone, tell someone near you.
esc_emergency.hi: Yeh zaroori hai. Abhi 112 par phone kijiye, ya turant sabse paas ke aspataal jaiye. Akele hain to paas mein kisi ko bataiye.
esc_emergency.bn: Eta joruri. Ekhuni 112-e phone korun, ba sobcheye kachher haspatale ekhuni jan. Eka thakle, pashe karo ke bolun.

esc_self_harm.en: I'm glad you told me. You can talk to someone right now, for free: call 14416. If you are in danger right now, call 112.
esc_self_harm.hi: Aapne bataya, achha kiya. Abhi kisi se baat kar sakte hain, muft: 14416 par phone kijiye. Agar abhi khatra hai, to 112 par phone kijiye.
esc_self_harm.bn: Apni bolechhen, khub bhalo korechhen. Ekhuni karo sathe kotha bolte paren, binamullye: 14416-e phone korun. Ekhuni bipod mone hole 112-e phone korun.

esc_urgent.en: A doctor should see this today. Please don't wait for a later appointment.
esc_urgent.hi: Ise aaj hi doctor ko dikhana chahiye. Baad ke appointment ka intezaar mat kijiye.
esc_urgent.bn: Eta ajkei doctor ke dekhano dorkar. Porer appointment er jonno opekkha korben na.

d_I_gas.en: Where exactly do you feel the gas, in the stomach or in the chest? Is there sweating, breathlessness, or pain going to the arm or jaw?
d_I_gas.hi: Gas thik kahan mehsoos ho rahi hai, pet mein ya seene mein? Kya pasina, saans phoolna, ya haath ya jabde tak dard hai?
d_I_gas.bn: Gas ta thik kothay lagchhe, pete na buke? Ghaam, shash koshto, ba haat ba choyal porjonto byatha achhe?

d_I_ghabrahat.en: What is the uneasiness like? Fear or worry, a racing heartbeat, feeling like vomiting, or pressure in the chest?
d_I_ghabrahat.hi: Ghabrahat kaisi hai? Dar ya chinta jaisi, dil tez dhadakna, ulti jaisa lagna, ya seene mein dabav?
d_I_ghabrahat.bn: Ghabrano ta kemon? Bhoy ba chinta, buk dhorphor, bomi bhab, na buke chap?

d_I_chakkar.en: What is the dizziness like? Does the room spin, do you feel you might fall, or can you not walk straight? Did it start suddenly?
d_I_chakkar.hi: Chakkar kaisa hai? Kamra ghoomta hai, ya lagta hai gir jayenge, ya seedha chal nahi pa rahe? Kya yeh achanak shuru hua?
d_I_chakkar.bn: Matha ghora ta kemon? Ghor ta ghurchhe mone hoy, na mone hoy pore jaben, na sojha hatte parchhen na? Hothat shuru holo ki?

d_I_kamzori.en: Is the weakness in the whole body, or on one side, in one arm or one leg? Did it come on suddenly?
d_I_kamzori.hi: Kamzori poore sharir mein hai, ya ek taraf, ek haath ya ek pair mein? Kya yeh achanak hua?
d_I_kamzori.bn: Durbolota puro shorire, na ek dike, ek haat ba ek paye? Hothat holo ki?

d_I_sunn.en: Is the numbness on one side only? Did it start suddenly? Any change in the face or in speech?
d_I_sunn.hi: Sunnpan sirf ek taraf hai? Kya achanak shuru hua? Chehre ya bolne mein koi badlav?
d_I_sunn.bn: Obosh bhab ta ki shudhu ek dike? Hothat shuru holo? Mukh ba kotha bolay kono bodol?

d_I_bp.en: Did someone measure the blood pressure, and what was it? And what exactly are you feeling right now?
d_I_bp.hi: Kya kisi ne BP naapa tha, kitna aaya? Aur abhi aap thik kya mehsoos kar rahe hain?
d_I_bp.bn: Keu ki pressure mepechhilen, koto chhilo? Ar ekhon thik ki mone hochhe?

d_I_sugar.en: Is there diabetes? Right now, is there sweating, shaking, or any confusion?
d_I_sugar.hi: Kya sugar ki bimari hai? Abhi pasina, kaanpna, ya kuch samajhne mein dikkat ho rahi hai?
d_I_sugar.bn: Sugar er rog achhe ki? Ekhon ghaam, kanpuni, ba kichhu bujhte osubidha hochhe?

d_I_saans_phoolna.en: Are you breathless even while sitting? Can you speak a full sentence? Is this new?
d_I_saans_phoolna.hi: Kya baithe-baithe bhi saans phoolti hai? Kya poora vaakya bol pa rahe hain? Kya yeh nayi baat hai?
d_I_saans_phoolna.bn: Bose thakleo ki hanpan? Puro kotha bolte parchhen? Eta ki notun?

d_I_jalan.en: Where is the burning? When passing urine, in the stomach or chest, or on the skin?
d_I_jalan.hi: Jalan kahan hai? Peshab karte waqt, pet ya seene mein, ya twacha par?
d_I_jalan.bn: Jala ta kothay? Prosraber somoy, pete ba buke, na chamrar opor?

d_I_garmi_thand.en: Is there a fever? Did anyone measure it? Since when?
d_I_garmi_thand.hi: Kya bukhar hai? Kisi ne naapa? Kab se hai?
d_I_garmi_thand.bn: Jor achhe ki? Keu mepechhe? Kobe theke?

d_I_tension.en: How have sleep and eating been? Have you ever had thoughts of harming yourself?
d_I_tension.hi: Neend aur khana kaisa chal raha hai? Kya kabhi khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ka khayal aaya hai?
d_I_tension.bn: Ghum ar khawa daoa kemon cholchhe? Kokhono nijer khoti korar kotha mone hoyechhe?
